lyrics.original: やわらかな風が この世界ごと包み込んで
lyrics.romanization: yawarakana kaze ga kono sekaigoto tsutsumikonde
lyrics.english: A gentle breeze envelops this whole world

lyrics.original: 僕らの背中を押すよ Oh
lyrics.romanization: bokura no senaka o osu yo oh
lyrics.english: And pushes us forward Oh

lyrics.original: 期待と不安
lyrics.english: Hope and anxiety

lyrics.original: 入り混じった心がまたこそばゆくて
lyrics.romanization: iri majitta kokoro ga mata kosobayukute
lyrics.english: Tangled together makes my heart tingle

lyrics.original: ほどけた蕾のよう
lyrics.english: Like an unraveling bud

lyrics.original: 芽吹き始めた希望 夢
lyrics.english: Newly sprouted hopes and dreams

lyrics.original: 心の奥で抱きしめ
lyrics.english: Holding them deep in my heart

lyrics.original: どんな夜も超えて 君と咲かせたい
lyrics.romanization: donna yoru mo koete kimi to sakasetai
lyrics.english: No matter the night, I want to make them bloom with you

lyrics.original: きっと 色褪せることはない
lyrics.english: Their color will surely never fade

lyrics.original: 桜色Yell 君に届け
lyrics.english: Sakura colored cheer, hope it reaches you

lyrics.original: 離れても 変わらずに 味方でいるから
lyrics.romanization: hanarete mo kawarazu ni mikata de iru kara
lyrics.english: Even if we’re apart, I’ll always be by your side

lyrics.original: 何年後の 未来だって
lyrics.english: No matter how many years into the future

lyrics.original: また会える 約束をかわそう
lyrics.english: Let’s promise we’ll meet again

lyrics.original: 鮮やかな花も せわしい日々を生きてると
lyrics.romanization: azayaka na hana mo sewashii hibi o ikiteru to
lyrics.english: Even vivid flowers, when living busy days

lyrics.original: モノクロに見えてしまうよ Oh
lyrics.romanization: monokuro ni miete shimau yo oh
lyrics.english: Can start to look monochrome Oh

lyrics.original: 心配ない 迷った時にはいつも
lyrics.romanization: shinpai nai mayotta toki ni wa itsumo
lyrics.english: But don’t worry, whenever you feel lost

lyrics.original: 大切な記憶が 胸に光るよ
lyrics.romanization: taisetsu na kioku ga mune ni hikaru yo
lyrics.english: Precious memories will shine through in your heart

lyrics.original: 今思えばひとりよがりの日々も
lyrics.romanization: ima omoeba hitoriyogari no hibi mo
lyrics.english: Looking back, even those self-centered days

lyrics.original: 振り向けば君が隣にいた
lyrics.romanization: furimukeba kimi ga tonari ni ita
lyrics.english: When I turned around, you were always there beside me

lyrics.original: これからもずっと変わらずずっと
lyrics.romanization: kore kara mo zutto kawarazu zutto
lyrics.english: From now on and forever, like I always have

lyrics.original: この場所で君を待ってる
lyrics.romanization: kono basho de kimi o matteru
lyrics.english: I’ll be right here waiting for you

lyrics.original: 桜色Yell 君に届け
lyrics.english: Sakura colored cheer, hope it reaches you

lyrics.original: 誰よりも すぐそばに 感じられるから
lyrics.romanization: dare yori mo sugu soba ni kanjirareru kara
lyrics.english: 'Cause I can feel you closer than anyone else

lyrics.original: 何回でも 思い出して
lyrics.english: Over and over, just remember

lyrics.original: いつまでも 結ばれた 絆を
lyrics.romanization: itsu made mo musubareta kizuna o
lyrics.english: The bond that ties us together forever

lyrics.original: Always the only one
lyrics.english: Always the only one

lyrics.original: ヒラヒラと舞う花びら
lyrics.english: Petals fluttering in the breeze

lyrics.original: 僕たちを彩る Magic
lyrics.english: A magic that colors our lives

lyrics.original: 歩いてこう 花道を さあ
lyrics.english: Let’s walk down this path of flowers

lyrics.original: いくつ季節が移り変わったって
lyrics.english: No matter how many seasons pass

lyrics.original: 僕たちはいつも
lyrics.english: We will always

lyrics.original: 繋がってるから強くなれる
lyrics.english: Stay connected, and that makes us strong

lyrics.original: 桜色Yell 君に届け
lyrics.english: Sakura colored cheer, hope it reaches you

lyrics.original: 離れても 変わらずに 味方でいるから
lyrics.romanization: hanarete mo kawarazu ni mikata de iru kara
lyrics.english: Even if we’re apart, I’ll always be by your side

lyrics.original: 何年後の 未来だって
lyrics.english: No matter how many years into the future

lyrics.original: また会える 約束をかわそう
lyrics.english: Let’s promise we’ll meet again

lyrics.original: Always the only one
lyrics.english: Always the only one
